visual.general_description: Grayscale apical cardiac ultrasound sector with chamber labels and white arrows.; Color-flow cardiac ultrasound view with arrows.; Grayscale ultrasound image with IDH label and triangular marker.
visual.detailed_description: 3 side-by-side lettered cardiac ultrasound panels. A: A triangular gray speckled sector is displayed on black. Dark chambers are labelled RA,RV,LA and LV; a smaller dark pocket near the upper apex is labelled IDH. Multiple white arrows point toward its boundaries; an oval A label sits at lower right. B: Gray sector image contains a rectangular color box. Blue pixels lie above and left of a red/orange column near the labelled LV. White arrows converge around the central colored boundary and upper dark pocket; oval B label is at lower right. Color represents displayed Doppler overlay; direction/velocity is not inferred from red/blue alone. C: A dark upper pocket labelled IDH is bordered by gray tissue. A yellow triangle outlined in blue sits along its left side. White chamber walls lead downward into a larger dark chamber; oval C label is at lower right. No readable numeric lesion dimension is printed.
